evidence.scope: Read-only source and complete retained archive-lineage inspection plus pure memory-backed validation. Each validator means offline packets, pre-ACK schema/schedule/state, and full oracle unless qualified. Retained suites were not rerun; full replay replaced only filesystem read/absence adapters.

findings.location: oracle.py:776 validate_packet_order BIND; witness_owner.py:1119 PacketState.validate BIND and descriptor schemas
findings.producer: collector.c:107 high_fd returns fd unchanged when fd >= 3; a successful relocation of fd 0..2 returns a descriptor >= 3. Attempt directories, sinks and pipe ends pass through high_fd at :157, :173 and :519.
findings.mutation: For every reached BIND, move an original fd >= 3 to new_fd 30, updating subsequent report I/O when applicable; separately change create fd/return and both BIND descriptors to 0. Also independently set all directory descriptors, all request descriptors, or each EOF descriptor to 0.
findings.observed: All 49 invalid variants pass both packet validators and complete memory-backed oracle.validate.
findings.correction: Enforce the exact high_fd transition: old_fd >= 3 requires new_fd == old_fd; old_fd 0..2 requires new_fd >= 3 and an unoccupied destination. Require directory, request I/O and EOF pipe descriptors to be >= 3. Preserve legitimate raw low-number opens followed by relocation and subsequent reuse.

findings.location: oracle.py:648,730,771 validate_packet_order; witness_owner.py:925 validate_packet_schema and :1065 PacketState.validate
findings.producer: inject.h:13 reserves SF_WITNESS_FD 198; sf_exchange at :110 sends every packet through it. collector.patch:44 closes the EOF descriptor before sf_observe_eof sends its record.
findings.mutation: Independently use fd 198 as the directory, successful create/BIND capability, BIND destination, request I/O descriptor, or each of the three EOF closed_fd values; maintain existing joins.
findings.observed: All 49 variants pass both packet validators and the complete memory-backed oracle, including EOF claims that close the very socket needed to deliver that EOF packet.
findings.correction: Reserve fd 198 throughout the collector witness lifetime and reject aliases in directory, acquisition, BIND, I/O and EOF fields in both validators. Add every-role negatives without changing the transport protocol.

findings.producer: collector.c:157 holds the attempt-directory inode until :890, while :167 and :818 create regular files. Its same device/inode cannot simultaneously identify a regular file.
findings.mutation: At each successful create, set target_stat.ino and matching BIND/I/O inode fields to the retained directory inode 90, keeping device 1 and regular-file mode. Separately set all request target inode fields to 90.
findings.observed: All 18 variants pass both packet validators and the complete memory-backed oracle while the persistent directory remains device 1, inode 90, directory mode.
findings.correction: Reject witnessed regular-file device/inode pairs equal to the still-live attempt-directory pair in both validators. Add create and request negatives across selectors while preserving arbitrary legitimate device/inode values and directory-size changes.
